match.questionText: Examine the role of civil society organizations in strengthening democracy in India.

points.text: Defines civil society organisations as the space between state, market and family (NGOs, SHGs, trade unions, advocacy groups)
Watchdog role: holding government accountable, social audits, exposing corruption
Policy advocacy that shaped laws, with an example such as the RTI Act or MGNREGA
Voice and representation for marginalised groups
Service delivery and last-mile implementation in health, education or disaster relief
Civic and voter awareness, deepening participation
Challenges: funding and FCRA regulation, accountability and transparency of CSOs, politicisation
Balanced conclusion, e.g. a regulatory framework that ensures CSO accountability without curbing dissent
